stayType: Beachside campsite with glamping and surf hire
accommodation: Tent pitches (tents up to six-person), campervan/van pitches up to 7m, roof-tent pitches, glamping
suitableFor: Surfers, couples, friends and families camping in tents or vans; not dog owners
beachAccess: Beside Croyde Bay, 'within touching distance' of the beach (official site)
confirmedFeatures: Surf hire, glamping, on-site food (Biffen's Kitchen, Waves and Waffles)
overview: Ocean Pitch is a small campsite beside Croyde Bay, taking tents, campervans up to seven metres and roof tents, with some glamping. It has its own surf hire and two food outlets on site. Dogs, caravans and large motorhomes are not accepted.
surfTripFit: Right next to the beach with surf hire on site, it is about as close to the Croyde break as camping gets; the 2026 season ran 2 April to 1 October.
gaps: Parking, showers and board/wetsuit storage not described (facilities page not opened); 2027 dates not yet seen.
